disclosureLanguage: This lecture uses an original generated instructor and synthetic voice for an Open Education Suite lesson.
voiceConsentRule: Use only project-owned synthetic voices or voices with explicit recorded consent for this course package.
likenessConsentRule: Use only synthetic non-real-person likenesses or real-person likenesses with explicit recorded consent for this course package.
prohibitedUses: real-person voice cloning without explicit consent
real-person likeness cloning without explicit consent
false claims about being human or live
learnerFacingTransparency: Show the generated instructor disclosure near lecture playback, transcript, and package metadata.

likeness.visualStyle: front-row classroom instructor with minimal visual distraction

mannerisms.gaze: Looks toward the learner during prompts and toward the board during diagrams.
